title: Scroll Colour Shift
summary: The page background changes per section.
description: The page background changes per section.
accessibility_notes: Scroll-linked motion must be disabled under prefers-reduced-motion, and content must never depend on scrolling to become readable.
ai_usage: Story pages. Transition the background on the root and change it via IntersectionObserver per section; per-section backgrounds produce visible seams at the boundaries.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Scroll Colour Shift</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "scroll-color-shift",
    "title": "Scroll Colour Shift",
    "summary": "The page background changes per section.",
    "description": "The page background changes per section.",
    "theme": "scroll-effects",
    "categories": ["scroll", "motion"],
    "tags": ["scroll", "color", "sections", "scroll", "transition"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "intermediate",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Scroll-linked motion must be disabled under prefers-reduced-motion, and content must never depend on scrolling to become readable.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--dur", "description": "Transition", "default": "0.6s" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Retune through the custom properties", "Add a reduced-motion static variant"],
    "ai_usage": "Story pages. Transition the background on the root and change it via IntersectionObserver per section; per-section backgrounds produce visible seams at the boundaries."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; }
    body { background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; }
    body { margin: 0; transition: background-color .6s ease; background: #0b0d12; }
    section { height: 100vh; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <section data-bg="#0b0d12">Midnight</section><section data-bg="#1e1b4b">Indigo</section>
  <section data-bg="#042f2a">Deep teal</section><section data-bg="#451a03">Amber</section>
  <script>
    (function () {
      new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
        es.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) document.body.style.background = e.target.dataset.bg; });
      }, { threshold: .5 }).observe && document.querySelectorAll("section").forEach(function (s) {
        new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
          es.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) document.body.style.background = e.target.dataset.bg; });
        }, { threshold: .5 }).observe(s);
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
